{"consolidated_memory":"**Truncated documents in search/indexer/chunker.ts — Two separate incidents**

File: search/indexer/chunker.ts (search side)
Symptom (both occasions): chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
Repro (both occasions): index the long changelog fixture

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-06-02]**
Trigger: First request after a cold start
Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
PR: #5169 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1
Outcome: Job finished in 45 minutes instead of 3 hours

**OCCASION 2: [2026-08-18]**
Trigger: Two requests raced on the same key
Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR: #8290 on branch fix/truncated-documents-3
Outcome: Backlog cleared 12 minutes after the deploy

---

Context: Same corner of search/indexer/chunker.ts addressed in both incidents; context carried over from earlier truncated documents work."}
